video_title: Bucks WORST Start In Franchise History!

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Milwaukee Bucks' struggles and failure to pass the eye test
quotes.excerpt: They don't pass the eye test. We are a group that always talks about the eye test.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: I don't know if you want to say worst team in the league, maybe that's a little too hurtful, but is this the worst team in the league?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: They are going through some real growing pains. I thought that Tyler Herro, Kyle Kuzma, and the Turner connect was going to be a good matchup for them. I liked AJ Green and what he was able to do in the past. It just hasn't lined up. I am not going to say they are the worst team in the league. I hate to throw this shot, but Sacramento has been consistently bad and they are right there in the boat with Milwaukee, being at the bottom of the barrel. But both of those teams have enough talent to not be in the positions they are in. You have to give respect where it is due and sometimes respect can be a positive thing and sometimes respect can put a diss on the front of it. That is where this Milwaukee Bucks team is. They don't pass the eye test. We are a group that always talks about the eye test.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins' reaction to the Damian Lillard trade
quotes.excerpt: They traded a top-five player. I mean, I don't know what I didn't expect them to be good.
quotes.quote: They traded a top-five player. I mean, I don't know what I didn't expect them to be good. I thought they were going to be decent. Hero and Ware coming over, those were the guys that were in this trade for Giannis Antetokounmpo. I thought they were going to at least be competent. I am not going to say they were going to be a top-five team, but one and 14? I didn't see that coming.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Denver Nuggets' chemistry and the duo of Jokic and Murray
quotes.excerpt: They have a dynamic one-two punch. When you have two guys like that that have that much chemistry.
quotes.quote: When you start talking about top-five players, you have to. They have Nikola Jokic, they have Jamal Murray, and I seen an interesting stat last night that they got a thousand assists to each other. How crazy is that? That is a dynamic one-two punch. When you have two guys like that that have that much chemistry and have won a championship together and have played X amount of years together, they are always going to have an opportunity to compete. I like what Christian Braun is bringing to the table. I like DeMar DeRozan being another guy that you can rely on to finish plays and to play in the fourth quarter with you, to put them out there with Aaron Gordon. I think they have a great group of veteran guys that know what it looks like to win, know what it takes to win, and I think they will give a lot of teams some headaches if they can keep it together.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons' assessment of the Denver Nuggets' championship window
quotes.excerpt: I think they are going to be a championship team, I think we will see as the season goes on.
quotes.quote: I agree and they have Nikola Jokic, right? We know how good he is and we know this team has that consistency. They had the foundation, they have been together for a long time, so the slow start was a little interesting and it made some people be like, oh, their window is closing. I don't really look at them like that. I think they are going to be a championship team, I think we will see as the season goes on. It is crazy to me that they are eight and five, 13 games into the season. It is the first time we have talked about them, which is interesting. So I don't know if that is just the depth of the league and how much talent and how these other teams have been more surprising and good, but Denver is one of those teams where you just look at the end of the season and they are right there and they are going to be a tough out come playoff time, if they are healthy.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins' belief that the Nuggets' championship window is closed
quotes.excerpt: I do believe the championship window is closed. Don't quite have the shooting that we're accustomed to seeing.
quotes.quote: I think they are still a good team, I think they are still a dangerous team, but I do believe the championship window is closed. Don't quite have the shooting that we're accustomed to seeing from this group. The team defense isn't quite up to par as what we're accustomed to seeing. Still a dangerous team, still a good team, obviously a threat every night with a player like Nikola Jokic. He is going to do what he does, but I believe the championship window is closed.
